NTT operates a global data center business, NTT Global Data Centers, under NTT DATA, Inc. The operators own about us page, fetched this session, states NTT DATA is a top 10 global IT services provider with about 30 billion dollars in annual revenue, operations across 33 countries, and about 3 billion dollars in annual research and development investment, headquartered at the Toyosu Center Building, 3-3-3 Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo 135-6033, Japan, though these figures describe the wider NTT DATA organization rather than the data center division specifically, and no data center division formation or acquisition date was found on the pages fetched this session. A previously confirmed, specific data center acquisition remains NTT Communications purchase of an 86.7 percent stake in e-shelter, described as Germany top data center operator, completed around June 23, 2015, though that acquisition is not directly connected to this United States facility. reading.body:
NTT Ashburn VA7 Data Center in Ashburn, Virginia, publishes 36 MW of IT capacity across 125,000 square feet of technical space, operated by NTT.

At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, that load supports roughly 3600 racks. At 40 kW per rack, a density closer to AI training workloads, it supports roughly 900 racks. The operator has not published a per-rack power envelope, so neither figure is the operator's own claim, only what the published megawattage implies under each assumption.

No compliance certifications are published for NTT Ashburn VA7 Data Center. That does not mean none exist, only that this site's dataset, built from the operator's own facility page, does not list any, which limits what regulated workloads a reader could confirm the facility is qualified to host.

Virginia has 26 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 20 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 1338.6 MW. NTT Ashburn VA7 Data Center contributes 36 MW of that total. That is a meaningful facility by colocation standards, though still below the scale where frontier AI training clusters typically operate.
